notes.title: 1.4: Egypt, Powerups, Emotes, and More!
notes.content:
[b]New Map: Egypt[/b]
-Behold the wonders of Ancient Egypt! Sneak past cobras, delve into the pyramids, and solve mysterious puzzles. [b]EDIT: Hole 13 crash fixed! Sorry bout that![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/0de599e398973abd66fa28dcaef781cbf78e921c.gif[/img]

[b]New Powerups[/b]
-[i]Powerups[/i] - cause chaos and consternation for other golfers: 
Smokescreen - Unleash massive clouds of noxious smoke obscuring vision
Lava Pool - Lay down pools of deadly lava
Tar - Lay down a sticky trail of tar that will ensnare unsuspecting golf balls
Ice - Lay down a trail of ice that will coat golf balls in slick ice
Slime - Drip green slime everywhere that will cause golf balls to move randomly
Airstrike - Call in a precision bomb... Watch out though, it can get you too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/a98330e84482e75d1bd0fa404a3f08cd446751c5.gif[/img]

[b]Other New Settings[/b]
-[i]New Ball Shapes[/i]: Pyramid, Donut, Lemon, Pear, Pineapple, Banana, Chicken ball shapes.
-[i]Ball Size[/i]: Small, Medium, Big ball sizes.
-[i]Collision[/i]: Absurd Collision (10x power)
-[i]Gravity[/i]: Moon, Mars, Earth, or Jupiter level gravity.
-[i]Bounciness[/i]: Zero, Low, Medium, High level bounciness.

[b]New Items[/b]
-You can now unlock Emotes! Once you get an emote, select it in your customize menu, and press "E" to use in-game. The first generation of emotes is: Disco Party, Make It Rain!, Sad Trombone, Tiny Violin, Cowbell. Emote drop rates have been boosted so collect them now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/3eae8d7b9dfcc2375e428868ea8e0d0090f74698.png[/img]

[b]New Achievements[/b]
Egypt Par - Shoot par on Egypt!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/618f00597bc000502a222bcc6d8790a888622eb3.png[/img]
Tarred! - Get covered in sticky tar!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/0f8e39e1cc2b45d437c8b60a1486a105186f093c.png[/img]
Iced! - Get covered in slippery ice!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/78988794f99cfc9dffd2e12df355a463cfe19415.png[/img]
Slimed! - Get covered in nasty green slime! Ew...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/3cd842fc833108e591ab83aee46190826a25aa0a.png[/img]
Diced Pineapple - Get diced as a pineapple shape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/df38841448efeb202f68b9cdfa3f0fbad1c43469.png[/img]
Fresh Squeezed Lemonade - Get flattened as a lemon shape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/494de19c115197a36d511bbb6b30c18113a0eea7.png[/img]
Roast Chicken - Get roasted as a chicken shape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/eeff20f5bd5ed881666cb198a7b79b2ba83479ed.png[/img]
Tarred and Feathered - Get tarred as a chicken shape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/baf5a0cd8df572706638f55a5e4c3a09c7de0bf1.png[/img]

[b]New Editor Content[/b]
-New in level editor: Egypt environment & 19 new mechanics, including animals, destructible items, traps, puzzle gates, and new goal types.
-New OST track and flag style.
-3 new goal types and new custom text font.

[b]Misc[/b]
-The host player can now cancel a game and return everyone to the lobby, preserving all setup.
-Keyboard settings for Emote [E] and Powerup [Q].

[b]Notes[/b]
Thanks to the map making community (Folks like Squirmy Router, Xen and many more) for helping to keep the game alive! Let me know if you encounter bugs with this update on Steam Forums or Discord. Thanks for playing!

-Steve

notes.title: Update 1.2: Model Importer
notes.content:
Golf Around now has an importer for custom 3D models! You can import your own or get models from others on the Workshop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/4ce9d3baa2f46d1f7cabbffb6e25e0500893dad8.png[/img]

Read the full Importer guide here:
[url=https://www.golfaroundgame.com/importer]https://www.golfaroundgame.com/importer[/url]

The model format is .OBJ only, with optional .MTL files for materials. (You can export this format from Blender easily.) Animations are not supported, sorry.
Each asset is a unique workshop item, which you can make private or public.
Assets are also fully embedded in the map files, so they won't break if the assets aren't present.

If you need any help using it, join our Discord here and ask for help: [url=https://discord.gg/h6vzVq5]https://discord.gg/h6vzVq5[/url] 

[b]Keep in mind this is a new tool and will probably need some fixes. If you find a bug it's very helpful to report it on Discord or the forums![/b]

notes.title: Golf Around 1.0! (New Game Mode)
notes.content:
Golf Around is ready for full release!

A new game mode has been added! Swing mode will test your golfing skills in a new way, by swinging a club rather than charging your shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/6c381dee85d5aa197f2b5d37739ca047f883746f.png[/img]

There have also been various fixes and a new mechanic added to the Vaporwave theme.

Over the course of Early Access there were 7 updates:
-Shapes Update
-Vaporwave Update
-Summer Sale Update
-Haven Update
-Steampunk & OST & UI Update
-Localization Update
-Swing Mode Update (This one)

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game throughout Early Access! A special thanks to the map makers, as of right now there are 397 maps on the workshop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/b05372d527aa3b13b4f60b36d7443261c8a019fc.png[/img]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Map: Steampunk and More!
notes.content:
Update 0.9 is now out! Try a new map, listen to the new 9-song OST, and use 10 new mechanics in the editor!

The price has been increased with this update to USD 4.99 or equivalent. The game should still be pretty affordable.

[b]New Map[/b]

The Steampunk map is now out, featuring new mechanics and a new environment!
"In a palace of glass, devious clockwork spins and machines fly through the air."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/abf225dfe8d3dd61f6121509ee5584c1b16831d1.png[/img]

[b]New Editor Content[/b]

The Editor now features a [b]global water setting[/b], so with the terrain editor you can make islands, rivers, and more. There are also 10 new mechanics (8 Steampunk, 1 Lab, 1 Vaporwave), and the Steampunk environment.

[b]New OST[/b]

9 Original Tracks (24:14 runtime):
Intro (1:51)
Village (2:58)
Dungeon (3:21)
Dungeon Boss (0:39)
Snowy (2:29)
Lab (3:01)
Vaporwave (3:54)
Haven (2:52)
Steampunk (3:09)

This original soundtrack will replace the stand-in music that was used before. I know some people liked the old music, but I'm shifting the game towards original content instead of assets. I may change and add to the OST over time.

[b]New Achievements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/2691db03213b52c83275b12b95cb53178c339aa9.png[/img]
Steampunk Par
Shoot par on Steampunk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/f4af4338f9ecd0d4c027af59882f2a5138be20d4.png[/img]
Flattened!
Get flattened into a pancake!

[b]Map Visual Update[/b]

The Village and Snowy maps have received a visual update, with new buildings and vegetation. The old buildings have been made legacy-only. I know that decreases the variety, but I will add much more original content over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/93bb52cc41655bcac2288e9284f46979eddda2d2.png[/img]

[b]UI Visual Update[/b]

The UI has received a visual update, with a new font, new button graphics, and an updated scoreboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/e4a420ee7f3c75a59ce892fcdf2a2192c7771d5c.png[/img]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Map: Haven
notes.content:
A new map is here for Golf Around! Haven is a pirate island where you can blast out of cannons, make friends with seagulls, and look out from the crow's nest. Haven also includes an editor theme with a new modular building system as well as the new mechanics. Also there is an achievement and new music track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/8e242e68bc5ab50560d86753eb14456af529a879.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/1993168aaa7c57955c4ffd1660daf0843cc3d8f2.png[/img]

Some things are not yet in the editor, like water - many updates are possible.

The workshop is growing steadily, reaching 130 community maps. Nitro's "Abandoned Town of MiniGolf 18 Holes" holds the most subscribed spot, can anyone knock him off the throne?

notes.title: Vaporwave Update + Sale! [0.6.0]
notes.content:
As a special promotion, the game is on sale for TWO WEEKS!

Ever wanted to golf in a highly aesthetic 80s atmosphere? Now you can. Vaporwave is the most difficult map yet. Watch out for the katanas.

Vaporwave has also been added to the editor, with all basic props and 40+ unique props. It has a new par achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/ab2bf98451e73269c29954a5d9bb340a9fa4b412.png[/img]

The editor now has custom text where you can type your own message, under Special. There's a new group of settings where you can pick a base terrain, skybox, and music. (Not a terrain editor, but you can pick the main texture.) The editor is now at 774 objects including texture variants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965311/eeae344646e4c23dc3cfdad435b9333631b1dde1.png[/img]

notes.title: Golf Around! is released!
notes.content:
Golf Around is now out! It will be available for -34% off for the next week! If you'd like to join our Discord here is the link: https://discord.gg/h6vzVq5

Golf Around! is a multiplayer Mini Golf game with crazy golf courses. In addition, you can easily play and create custom levels!
New content is continually being developed.

Features:
[list]
[*] Online multiplayer and single player
[*] A level creator with many community maps
[*] 4 built in courses: Village, Dungeon, Snowy and Lab
[*] A wide variety of game options and modes
[*] Steam Items to customize your ball
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Much more to come!
[/list]
